source:
cargo-features = ["namespaces", "profile-rustflags"]
badges = { maintenance = { status = "actively-developed" } }
features = { default = ["dep:a"], "café" = [], "x+y" = ["a/serde"] }
project = { name = "shadow", version = "9.8.7" }
lib = { name = "ascii", crate-type = ["rlib"], crate_type = ["staticlib"], path = "src/naïve.rs", filename = "artifact", test = true, doctest = false, bench = true, doc = false, doc-scrape-examples = true, proc-macro = false, proc_macro = true, harness = false, required-features = ["café"], edition = "2024" }
bin = [{ name = "tool", path = "src/bin.rs" }]
example = [{ name = "example", test = true }]
test = [{ name = "integration", harness = false }]
bench = [{ name = "bench", bench = true }]
hints = { mostly-unused = { z = nan, a = -0.0 } }

[package]
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.96"
name = "café::outil"
version = " 1.2.3-alpha.1+build.7 "
authors = ["Author"]
build = ["first.rs", "second.rs"]
metabuild = "builder"
default-target = "aarch64-apple-darwin"
forced-target = "wasm32-unknown-unknown"
links = "native"
exclude = ["tmp/**"]
include = ["src/**"]
publish = ["private"]
workspace = ".."
im-a-teapot = true
autolib = false
autobins = true
autoexamples = false
autotests = true
autobenches = false
default-run = "tool"
description = "description"
homepage = "https://example.com"
documentation = "https://example.com/docs"
readme = false
keywords = ["one"]
categories = ["development-tools"]
license = "MIT"
license-file = "LICENSE"
repository = "https://example.com/repo"
resolver = "3"
metadata = { z = [1, true, "s"], a = { date = 2026-09-05, time = 01:02:03.123456789, utc = 2026-09-05T01:02:03Z, offset = 2026-09-05T01:02:03+00:00 } }
unknown = { nested = [false, 1] }

[dependencies]
a = "1"
b = { version = "^2", registry = "my-registry", registry-index = "https://registry.example", path = "../b", base = "sources", git = "https://example.com/b", branch = "main", tag = "tag", rev = "deadbeef", features = ["serde"], optional = true, default-features = false, default_features = true, package = "renamed", public = false, artifact = ["bin", "cdylib"], lib = true, target = "target", unused = { z = 1, a = 2 } }
c = { workspace = true, features = ["feature"], default-features = false, default_features = true, optional = false, public = true, extra = "retained" }
[dev-dependencies]
a = "1"
[dev_dependencies]
b = "2"
[build-dependencies]
a = "3"
[build_dependencies]
b = "4"
[target.'cfg(unix)'.dependencies]
a = "1"
[target.'cfg(unix)'.dev-dependencies]
a = "2"
[target.'cfg(unix)'.dev_dependencies]
b = "3"
[target.'cfg(unix)'.build-dependencies]
a = "4"
[target.'cfg(unix)'.build_dependencies]
b = "5"
[lints.rust]
unsafe_code = "forbid"
unused = { level = "warn", priority = -128, z = true, a = { first = 1 } }
[lints.clippy]
all = { level = { allow = [] }, priority = 127 }
[profile.dev]
opt-level = -7
lto = "thin"
codegen-backend = "llvm"
codegen-units = 4294967295
debug = "line-tables-only"
split-debuginfo = "packed"
debug-assertions = true
rpath = false
panic = "unwind"
overflow-checks = true
incremental = false
dir-name = "dev"
inherits = "release"
strip = false
rustflags = ["-Ctarget-cpu=native"]
trim-paths = ["object", "diagnostics", "macro", "object"]
hint-mostly-unused = true
[profile.dev.package.'*']
opt-level = 1
[profile.dev.package.'foo@1.2.3+build']
debug = 2
[profile.dev.build-override]
opt-level = "z"
[patch.'crates-io']
a = { path = "../a" }
[replace]
'a:1.2.3' = "2"
